note: Two family campgrounds off the park road: Sunrise (sites 1-30, 101-150 and the all-electric 201-237 loop) and Sunset (the 300 and 400 loops, nearly all non-electric). Group sites, an off-highway vehicle area, horse trails and a dog-training area are separate from the family loops. --Claude
